description: Conformance vectors for the memfold Memory Record. Each entry is validated with MemoryRecordSchema.safeParse from @memfold/core. 'valid' entries must parse and must round-trip through serializeRecord -> parseRecord to an equal record; 'invalid' entries must fail to parse. Paths are relative to this file's directory.

vectors.reason: type=fact, scope=project; a durable factual statement about the codebase.
type=preference, scope=global; a cross-project user preference, scope_path null.
type=decision, scope=project; an architectural decision with provenance, links and confidence < 1.
type=convention, scope=dir; a directory-scoped rule with scope_path and decay.pinned=true.
type=episodic, scope=session; a recall-only episode with decay.half_life_days and access stats.
type=task, scope=project; an open task with a decay.ttl_at hard expiry.
type=entity, scope=global; a person entity produced by consolidation.
Only the fields @memfold/core requires (id, rev, type, scope, body, content_hash, provenance, created_at, updated_at, hlc); exercises schema defaults and still round-trips.
Bad enum: scope='repository' is not one of global|project|dir|session.
Out of range: salience=1.5 exceeds the maximum of 1.
Bad enum: type='reminder' is not a known memory type.
schema_version=2 is not the required literal 1.
